form.label: SOC Lab Overview
form.description: Detection coverage exported from the SOC Lab rule set.

panel.title: SOC-001 - Multiple failed logons from a single source (brute force / p

search.query: index=* (EventCode=4625) | stats count as attempts dc(user) as user by src_ip | where attempts > 10 | sort - attempts

panel.title: SOC-002 - Successful logon from a source that had recent failed logons

search.query: index=* EventCode=4625 | stats count as fails dc(user) as user by src_ip | where fails > 3 | join src_ip [ search index=* EventCode=4624 | table _time src_ip user Account_Name ]

panel.title: SOC-003 - New user account created on a domain controller

search.query: index=* EventCode=4720 | table _time user Account_Name host TargetUserName

panel.title: SOC-004 - Account added to a privileged group
SOC-005 - Special privileges assigned to a new logon

search.query: index=* EventCode=4672 | search - user=\"svc_*\" | table _time user host PrivilegeList

panel.title: SOC-006 - Linux SSH brute force against a server

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=\"syslog\" \"Failed password\" | stats count by src_ip | where count > 8
